statement: Nvidia says it is working through supply constraints spanning chips, memory, packaging, power and data centers, plus downstream limits on land, power and shell.
why: Constraints stacked across upstream components and downstream facilities determine how much of the ordered demand can actually be delivered this cycle.

impact.mechanism: Long-lead memory, packaging, electrical equipment and shell availability cap deliverable systems regardless of chip output.

evidence.excerpt: chips, memory, packaging, power and data centers,

confidence.basis: Qualitative vendor statement carried by a single secondary outlet; no lead-time figures given.
